if test "$uid" = 0; then fact root 1; else fact root 0; fi
uname -s; uname -r; uname -v
if test -r /proc/self/status; then
 count=0
 while IFS= read -r line; do
  count=$((count+1)); test "$count" -le 128 || break
  case "$line" in CapInh:*|CapPrm:*|CapEff:*|CapBnd:*|CapAmb:*|NoNewPrivs:*|Seccomp:*) printf '%s\n' "$line";; esac
 done < /proc/self/status
fi
if test -r /sys/fs/selinux/enforce; then enforced=; IFS= read -r enforced < /sys/fs/selinux/enforce || :; case "$enforced" in 0|1) fact selinux_enforcing "$enforced";; *) fact selinux_enforcing unknown;; esac; else fact selinux_enforcing missing; fi

else fact openwrt_release missing; fact package_arch missing; fi

if test -r /etc/build.prop; then awk 'NR<=500 && /^ro\.build\.(display\.id|version\.release|version\.incremental)=/ {print}' /etc/build.prop; fi

# Read only the two confirmed ZTE version fields. Never print device_info JSON.
zte_version_facts() {
 if ! command -v ubus >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v jsonfilter >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v head >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v tr >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  fact zte_integrate_version not-assessed; fact zte_inner_version not-assessed; return
 fi
 # Capture at most 64 KiB plus one byte, including a separate RPC exit proof.
 # Keep stderr private and refuse a truncated response even if it resembles JSON.
 zte_reply=$({ if ubus -t 5 call zwrt_web device_info '{}' 2>/dev/null; then zte_code=0; else zte_code=$?; fi; printf '\nFR_ZTE_RPC_EXIT=%s\n' "$zte_code"; } 2>/dev/null | head -c 65537 | tr '\000' '?'; printf '.')
 zte_reply=${zte_reply%.}
 if test "${#zte_reply}" -ge 65537; then
  fact zte_integrate_version not-assessed; fact zte_inner_version not-assessed; return
 fi
 case "$zte_reply" in
  *'
FR_ZTE_RPC_EXIT=0
') zte_json=${zte_reply%'
FR_ZTE_RPC_EXIT=0
'};;
  *) fact zte_integrate_version not-assessed; fact zte_inner_version not-assessed; return;;
 esac
 for zte_field in integrate_version wa_inner_version; do
  case "$zte_field" in integrate_version) zte_fact=zte_integrate_version;; wa_inner_version) zte_fact=zte_inner_version;; esac
  # Preserve parser status while rejecting NUL before shell capture can discard it.
  zte_value=$({ printf '%s\n' "$zte_json" | jsonfilter -e "@.$zte_field" 2>/dev/null; zte_code=$?; printf '\nFR_ZTE_FIELD_EXIT=%s\n' "$zte_code"; } | tr '\000' '?'; printf '.')
  zte_value=${zte_value%.}
  case "$zte_value" in
   *'
FR_ZTE_FIELD_EXIT=0
')
    zte_value=${zte_value%'
FR_ZTE_FIELD_EXIT=0
'}
    zte_value=${zte_value%'
'}
    case "$zte_value" in
     ''|null) fact "$zte_fact" missing;;
     *[!A-Za-z0-9._+:/\ -]*) fact "$zte_fact" not-assessed;;
     *) if test "${#zte_value}" -le 256; then fact "$zte_fact" "$zte_value"; else fact "$zte_fact" not-assessed; fi;;
    esac;;
   *) fact "$zte_fact" not-assessed;;
  esac
 done
}
zte_version_facts
unset zte_reply zte_json zte_value zte_code zte_field zte_fact

safe_dir() {

 test "$owner" = 0 || return 1
 case "$mode" in ''|*[!0-7]*) return 1;; esac

}
tmp_stage_parent_safe() {
 test -d "$1" && test ! -L "$1" || return 1

 case "$mode" in ''|*[!0-7]*) return 1;; esac
 test -w "$1" || return 1

 test "$((0$mode & 022))" = 0 || test "$((0$mode & 01000))" != 0

limitations.en: OpenWrt 23.05.4/aarch64_cortex-a53 is the private runtime ABI. Arbitrary packages, dependencies and maintainer scripts are not guaranteed compatible. No feed/TLS network requests are made; opkg status is not run because it can create locks.

limitations.ru: Это исследование намеренно не подтверждает готовность записи. Нужны проверенный образ того же устройства, сверка разметки, отдельный план записи и проверки штатной процедуры восстановления. Узлы sensor_id/codec_id не читаются: даже чтение меняет защиту записи. В Windows восстановление пока не реализовано.
limitations.en: Research intentionally cannot approve restoration writes. Requires a verified image for the same device, layout validation, a separate write plan and the restore workflow checks. sensor_id/codec_id are never read: reads themselves change write protection. Restoration is not implemented on Windows.

limitations.ru: Компоненты, экспортируемые имена и схема API не доказывают наличие eUICC, доступ к ISD-R или установку профиля. Исследование не читает EID/ICCID/профили, не отправляет APDU и не переключает SIM. Проверенный путь приложения — 9eSIM V0, физический слот 1, B31; интернет компьютера для desktop, интернет модема для веб-панели.
limitations.en: Components, exported names and API schema do not prove eUICC presence, ISD-R access or profile installation. Research does not read EID/ICCID/profiles, send APDUs or switch SIMs. The tested application path is 9eSIM V0 in physical slot 1 on B31; desktop uses computer Internet, the web dashboard uses modem Internet.
